actions.summary: Autonomous research formulation requires robust inquiry frameworks. Inquiry-based learning models provide a structured environment for generating novel questions through multidisciplinary engagement, while administrative contact points serve as a constraint on how information flow is mediated in external systems.
actions.title: Operational Frameworks for Autonomous Research
